newsitem.title: UK: Palm oil firms in Europe on friendly export talk.
newsitem.headline: Palm oil firms in Europe on friendly export talk.

text.p: The European palm oil sector firmed slightly on Tuesday on the back of a similar move in Malaysian palm oil futures, traders said.
The move was triggered by expectations that June 1-25 Malaysian palm oil export data due for release later this week by cargo surveyor SGS (M) Sdn Bhd would be supportive.
At midday palm oils were $2.50 to $5 firmer. Trade remained light but was scattered throughout most of the sector.
Crude palm oil traded both Jul and Aug at $530, RBD oil at $512.50 and $510 for Jul and Aug/Sep respectively, while palm olein made $557.50 for last half Jul and $553.50 for Aug/Sep.
At the end of the morning session soft oils were 0.25 guilders down to 0.50 up, coconut oil was unchanged to $2.50 higher and palmkernel oil $5 to $10 firmer. No trades were reported in any of these.
